# Intermediate

<sub>**Intermediate** · about 3 hours · Verified against Claude Code v2.1.285 (stable) on 2026-10-05</sub>

One developer's setup, shaped to your project.

## Practice

Bring the checks in from the template, in your copy:

```bash
git fetch https://github.com/wesammustafa/claude-code-practice main
git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- checks capstone
```

## When to use what

- **Skills:** you give Claude the same instructions or workflow again and again.
- **Hooks:** something must happen every time at a set point in a session.

## By the end of this level you can

- [ ] Write a hook that enforces a rule, and show it firing.
